content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi Notification PDF 2026

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Law, Public Policy, Sociology, Political Science, Economics or a related social science, with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA; minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in empirical or socio-legal research Experience: Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in empirical or socio-legal research Other conditions: Strong analytical and report-writing skills, evidenced by published or policy work Proficiency in English Desirable: LL.M. or Master's degree in any of the above disciplines, with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA Experience leading qualitative fieldwork, preferably on courts, legal aid or access to justice Working knowledge of mixed-methods research, and thematic and content analysis Understanding of research ethics, including trauma-informed and data protection practices Knowledge of an Indian language

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Remuneration is based on qualifications and experience. Contractual engagement Duration: 1 year (Dec 1, 2026 – Aug 31, 2027)

Write "Lead Researcher Application - Ease of Justice Study" in the subject line. Include a cover letter in the body of the email. Email it on or before 15 November 2026.
